caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher with a wide body, narrow neck, and a curved handle attached to one side. The pitcher is primarily a beige or light brown color with shading that suggests its rounded form and gives it a three-dimensional appearance. The inner rim of the pitcher is painted a darker brown, and there is a decorative blue floral pattern on the body, consisting of three large flowers connected by a branch. The pitcher is placed centrally on a plain, light background, and there are no other objects present in the composition.
title: Stone Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
